title: Page — About

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: about_intro_heading
fields.default_value:
Parking Made Easy, Travel 
Made Better

fields.label: Paragraph 1
fields.name: about_intro_text_1
fields.default_value: Travel is stressful enough without worrying about where to leave your car. That's why Joy9 Park exists — to give travellers a safe, affordable place to park just minutes from JFK.

fields.label: Paragraph 2
fields.name: about_intro_text_2
fields.default_value: Our secure parking lot in Jamaica, NY has been serving airport travellers for years with round-the-clock access, barrier-controlled entry and a free shuttle that runs to every terminal. Whether you're away for a weekend or a month, your vehicle stays protected until the moment you return.

fields.label: Bio
fields.name: founder_text
fields.default_value: Built on a simple idea: that airport parking should be easy, fair and genuinely secure. After years of watching travellers struggle with overpriced lots and unreliable shuttles, our founder set out to build something better — a facility where the price you are quoted is the price you pay, and where every customer is treated like a neighbour rather than a booking reference.

fields.label: Subtext
fields.name: offer_subtext
fields.default_value: Everything you need for a stress-free trip

default_value.title: Secure Long Term Parking
default_value.text: Barrier-controlled entry, 24/7 monitoring and a fully fenced lot keep your vehicle safe for as long as you're away.

default_value.title: Free JFK Shuttle Service
default_value.text: Complimentary shuttles run around the clock to and from all six JFK terminals in just 5 to 7 minutes.

default_value.title: Affordable Daily Rates
default_value.text: Transparent pricing from $15 a day with no hidden fees and no credit card needed to check availability.

default_value.title: Easy Reservations
default_value.text: Book your spot online in a few clicks, or simply call us and pay by cash or Zelle when you arrive.

fields.label: Title
fields.name: about_fss_title
fields.default_value:
Ride to the Terminal 
in Minutes

fields.label: Text
fields.name: about_fss_text
fields.default_value: Our complimentary shuttle service runs 24/7 between our secure lot and all JFK terminals. No waiting, no hassle—just hop on and we'll have you at your terminal in minutes.

default_value.title: All JFK Terminals Covered
default_value.text: We serve all 6 JFK terminals including T1, T2, T4, T5, T7 and T8

default_value.title: 24/7 Availability
default_value.text: Early morning flight or late night arrival? We're always here

default_value.title: Luggage Friendly
default_value.text: Spacious vehicles accommodate all your luggage and travel gear

fields.label: Learn More Button Text
fields.name: about_fss_learn_more_text
fields.instructions: Links to the Why Choose Us section on the home page.

fields.label: Book Now Button Text
fields.name: about_fss_book_now_text
fields.instructions: Links to whichever page uses the Reserve a Spot template.

fields.label: Text
fields.name: how_text
fields.default_value: From the moment you book to the moment you drive away, the whole process takes just four simple steps. No paperwork queues, no shuttle waiting around and no surprises when you come back to collect your car.

default_value.title: Step 01. Reserve
default_value.text: Book online or call ahead to secure your parking spot for the dates you need.

default_value.title: Step 02. Arrive
default_value.text: Drive straight to our lot, check in at the gate and hand over your keys.

default_value.title: Step 03. Shuttle
default_value.text: Hop on our free shuttle and we'll have you at your terminal in 5 to 7 minutes.

default_value.title: Step 04. Return
default_value.text: Call us once you land and the shuttle will collect you and bring you back to your car.

fields.label: Paragraph 1
fields.name: mission_text_1
fields.default_value: To make airport parking near JFK genuinely simple — built on three things: convenience, security and honest pricing.

fields.label: Paragraph 2
fields.name: mission_text_2
fields.default_value: We believe travellers shouldn't have to worry about their car while they're away. That's why we invest in a secure, well-lit facility, keep our shuttle running 24/7 and quote every rate up front. No hidden charges, no long walks with luggage, and no wondering whether your vehicle will be there when you get back.

fields.label: Text
fields.name: about_contact_text
fields.default_value: Our facility is just 3 miles from JFK Airport, making it the perfect choice for travelers seeking quick and easy parking.

default_value.title: From Belt Parkway
default_value.text: Exit at Springfield Blvd, head north to 155th Street

default_value.title: From Nassau Expressway
default_value.text: Turn onto 155th Street, we're on the left
